touch-min.$description: Minimum touch target on tablet and phone

drawer-nav.$description: Left navigation drawer: module rail plus menu panel (1.2)

rail.$description: Module rail inside the navigation drawer (1.2)

rail-tab.$description: Height of a module rail tab: icon over label (1.2)

launcher.$description: Round module tile in the launcher (1.2)

launcher-item.$description: Width of a launcher item: tile plus a two-line label (1.2)

entity-text.$description: Minimum width of the name column in an entity header before it wraps (1.2)

hero-photo.$description: Minimum height of a photo hero (1.2)

photo-tile.$description: Width of a photo tile in a strip (1.2)

thumb.$description: Record thumbnail: the photo on animal record cards (DD-006)

bar.$description: Width of a bar in a widget bar chart (1.2)

day.$description: Width of a day in the week strip (1.2)

quick-add.$description: Icon square in a quick-add tile (1.2)

bar-height.$description: Height of the columns in a widget bar chart (1.2)

module-item.$description: Minimum width of an item in the module grid (1.2)

blur-glass.$description: Backdrop blur behind glass chips on photos (1.2)

popover.$description: Dropdown panels: site picker, filters (1.2, module homes)

popover-lg.$description: Wide dropdowns: module switcher, menu (1.2, module homes)

dialog-wide.$description: Wide dialogs: widget gallery, all modules (1.2, module homes)

icon-stroke.$description: Interface icon stroke: ANTZ Rounded icons render at the weight they are drawn, 2px on the 24px grid (DD-004).

border-width-hairline.$description: Hairline: selected outlines on high-density screens (one device pixel). Standard screens use --border-width, because half a pixel blurs there.

mask.$description: Masks that draw shapes in a token colour (the colour comes from the element background).
